WHO WE ARE

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.



Vultr Cares

 - 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

 - 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

 - Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

 - 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

 - Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

 - $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

 - Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

 - Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

 - Company paid Wellable subscription
   
   

Join Vultr

This role is responsible for understanding customer objectives, driving measurable business outcomes, maintaining executive relationships, and ensuring alignment across contractual commitments, operational performance, and long-term growth opportunities.

The ideal candidate brings strong business and technical acumen, experience managing large-scale enterprise infrastructure relationships, and the ability to navigate complex organizations with multiple executive, commercial, and technical stakeholders. Working closely with a dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM), Sales, Service Delivery, Support, and Engineering, the Strategic CSM provides leadership, coordination, and proactive account oversight throughout the customer lifecycle. This is a highly visible role requiring demonstrated success managing significant enterprise relationships, identifying and mitigating business risks, and building trusted customer partnerships.

 - Account Ownership: Serve as the primary post-sales business and relationship owner for a select portfolio of high-value Strategic accounts, maintaining accountability for customer engagement, account governance, business objectives, and overall relationship health.

 - Customer Outcomes: Develop and execute customer success plans that align Vultr's services and contractual commitments with the customer's business objectives, deployment milestones, operational expectations, and measurable success outcomes.

 - Service Delivery Coordination: Partner with Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Service Delivery, Support, and Engineering to maintain visibility into deployment milestones, service performance, contractual commitments, and operational risks, ensuring customer expectations and communications are effectively managed throughout the engagement.

 - Growth & Expansion: Identify and develop opportunities for account growth, renewal, and expansion by understanding customer requirements, infrastructure utilization, future capacity needs, and evolving business objectives. Twin Health  
 At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. 
 We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.
 Working here  
 Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.
 Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .
 With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.
 Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

In your first year you will establish trusted, consistent performance baselines across channels, find where the data does not add up, and tell us what is working and what is not.    Opportunity 
 This role is a unique opportunity to lead the insights that show what Twin’s program delivers. You won’t just run models; you’ll own rigorous, high-stakes claims analyses and turn them into findings that executives, partners, and clinical stakeholders can act on.
 As Manager, Healthcare Analytics, you’ll work at the intersection of causal inference, messy real-world claims data, and client-facing communication. You’ll own analyses from end to end, from raw claims extraction through methodology to a polished, decision-ready narrative. You’ll also lead and develop a team of analysts. Your focus is insights: program evaluation, cost and outcome trends, and evidence that informs partners and Twin’s own decisions. Performance guarantee design, measurement, and settlement are owned by Twin’s actuarial team, and you’ll partner closely with them so that insights and guarantee results tell a consistent story. This is a highly visible role, working closely with sales, client success, actuarial, and data teams.
 Candidates may be considered for multiple open roles across Twin Health throughout the review and interview process as our teams identify matching opportunities.
 Responsibilities  
- Lead rigorous claims analyses of medical and pharmacy data to evaluate program impact, cost trends, and clinical outcomes, applying causal inference methods suited to observational data, including difference-in-differences, propensity score matching and weighting, instrumental variables, and regression discontinuity.
- Stress-test every finding with sensitivity and robustness checks, including placebo tests, pre-trend analysis, negative controls, and specification-curve analyses, so you know the defensible range of a result before it is shared externally.
- Tailor results to the audience, from board-level summaries for executives to detailed methodology appendices for sophisticated partners and plain-language explanations for non-technical stakeholders.
- Partner with client-facing teams to scope analyses, set clear expectations about what the data can and can’t support, and translate findings into practical implications for operations and program design.

Legal and Executive Support

About Fullscript
   
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.  
This is your invitation. 
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity
Location: Ashland, Virgina 
*This role is based on-site in Ashland, Virginia. Relocation assistance is available, if needed, to help offset moving if the successful candidate does not already reside in the commutable area*
We’re looking for an experienced operations leader to help shape the future of our newly automated distribution center on-site in Ashland, Virginia. As Senior Warehouse Operations Manager, you’ll own day-to-day site performance while playing a central role in building out our automation capabilities, from implementing and optimizing robotics to redesigning workflows that help our people and technology work better together. This is a role for a trail-blazer who has experience building out automation and robotics capabilities from the ground up.
In addition, you’ll lead and develop a team of Supervisors and Warehouse Associates, setting clear expectations for excellence and providing the training, protocols and support they need to succeed. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you’ll turn operational insights into improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and order accuracy. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can deliver reliable results today while building the systems, automation processes, and team capabilities we’ll need to thrive as we scale.
What you'll do:
Steer the direction, inform and optimize the new automation workflow and robotics capabilities within the warehouse, to ensure highly effective process and measurable efficiencies.
Develop, train and mentor the warehouse team members including the Site leadership team, to ensure a cohesive and highly productive work environment that successfully hits KPIs consistently

Responsible for revenue monitoring, AR reconciliations, portfolio tracking, and financial analysis, generating reliable reporting for strategic decision-making while collaborating across teams to ensure an efficient and structured financial operation.
 Responsibilities 
 Accounts Receivable & Cash Flow Management 
- Oversee and manage the end-to-end Accounts Receivable (AR) process to ensure timely collections and portfolio health.
- Track outstanding invoices, monitor aging schedules, and proactively follow up on overdue accounts to accelerate cash recovery.
- Perform routine AR reconciliations, identifying and resolving ledger discrepancies or billing disputes promptly.
- Maintain accurate, up-to-date customer payment records, open balances, and account statuses.
- Assist in developing and updating cash flow projections to optimize liquidity and working capital planning.
 Financial Analysis, Budgeting & Forecasting 
- Analyze revenue, costs, and expenses to identify key financial variances and trends.
- Support the preparation of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and financial projections.
- Perform variance analysis comparing actual performance against budget and forecast, delivering actionable insights to management.
 Requirements 
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 2+ years of professional experience in Accounting, Finance, Accounts Receivable, or similar corporate roles.
- Solid, proven track record in Accounts Receivable (AR) processes, including billing, collections, ledger reconciliations, and portfolio tracking.
- Intermediate-to-advanced MS Excel proficiency (e.g., pivot tables, advanced formulas, data modeling).
- Hands-on experience working with financial ERPs or accounting software (e.g., Odoo, NetSuite, SAP, or similar).
- Advanced English level (B2 level or higher, written and spoken).
